summary: Today's briefing highlights significant legal rulings and regulatory actions impacting the retail sector, alongside developments in foreign investment and consumer rights.

bullets.text: Karnataka High Court refuses to quash the SFIO case against Razorpay directors, maintaining legal scrutiny on the fintech sector.
Delhi High Court restrains Commercial Law Publishers from copying Taxmann's headnotes, reinforcing intellectual property rights in legal publishing.
Consumer Affairs Secretary Nidhi Khare announces actions against misleading advertisements and dark patterns to strengthen consumer rights in India.
Amazon Bazaar targets India's value-commerce market with products priced below Rs 500, intensifying competition with Meesho and Shopsy.
Senior PMO official PK Mishra states that India's strong economic growth is attracting more foreign investors to stock markets.
